## bizOS CI / deploy webhook

Path: `POST /webhook/bizos/ci-failure`

Set `BIZOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET` to match GitHub/`N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.
GitHub-hosted runners cannot reach localhost; use **bizOS GitHub Actions Poll** or a reachable webhook URL.
Delivery: Mailpit (`BIZOS_OPS_MAILPIT_URL`) or `BIZOS_OPS_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

meta.description: Signed CI/deploy webhook. Delivers via Mailpit or an alert webhook.
